_comment: The NOVA nozzle. A 100 kN LOX/LH2 upper stage at Pc = 1000 psia, MR = 5.5, area ratio 40, and the reference case for every part of the tool: a truncated ideal contour solved by the method of characteristics, a generated combustion chamber, a regeneratively cooled jacket of sixty circular GRCop-42 channels carrying hydrogen at 3.4 kg/s from 12 MPa and 30 K, a hydrogen film at the chamber end, both volutes, a radiation-cooled C103 extension beyond an area ratio of three, and the exhaust plume at 5 kPa. The operating point matches the CEA validation case in tests/testCeaInterface.py. Two of the settings are deliberate rather than arbitrary. The plume ambient is 5 kPa, near 20 km, because an area ratio of 40 separates internally below about 35 kPa and no attached plume model describes a separated nozzle; at sea level the plume solvers correctly refuse. The C103 extension reports a negative temperature margin on this engine and is included anyway: Bartz scales with chamber pressure to the 0.8, so a 6.9 MPa hydrogen engine puts a coated columbium shell over its limit at any area ratio, which is the result the solver exists to report rather than a fault in it. See the validation section of radiativeCooling.py. Some features exclude each other and cannot all appear at once: divergingSectionType is one of tic, top, toc or cone, with cone fixed at a 15 degree half angle; channelType is one of circle, rectangular or helical; gasSideAxialModel is one of uniform, which holds one gas-side correlation constant along the wall as Bartz does, or measured, which scales it by the constants measured along a LOX/GH2 chamber and takes about 40 percent off the throat; minChannelWidth, channelCornerRadius and maxChannelDepth are read for rectangular and helical, maxChannelAspectRatio for rectangular only, and channelHelixAngle and channelAspectRatio for helical only; regenTruncationType is one of none, temp or er, and regenTruncationValue is read only when the type is not none; filmCoolingModel is one of hatchPapell or sp8124Entrainment. The README lists what each alternate does. Fields left null are not specified; a literal 0.0 is specified as zero, and the two are not the same thing.
